title: CTA Banners
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a user, I want to create customizable CTA banner components with various elements

So that I can effectively promote products, services, or events on our website

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:gorilla:</custom> Goal

The primary goal of the CTA Banner Component is to create an engaging, visually appealing element that drives user action. It serves as a prominent promotional tool on the website that can:

* Increase conversion rates by directing users to important landing pages, product details, or signup forms
* Highlight time-sensitive promotions, sales, or special events effectively
* Provide consistent branding while allowing for customization based on specific marketing campaigns
* Improve the visual appeal of various website sections through professional design elements
* Maintain accessibility while maximizing visual impact across all device types

This component will empower marketing teams to create compelling calls-to-action without requiring developer assistance for each new campaign or promotion.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

**These requirements apply to all banners:**

* **Title:** The banner should display a prominent title that can be customized
* **Subline:** The banner should include a secondary text line that provides additional information
* **CTA Button:** The banner should include a customizable call-to-action button with configurable text and link

    * The button variant should be selectable / changeable in style and sizing (_For example, if someone would like to have the secondary small button instead of the primary medium button. Or simply a ghost button._)
    
* **Background Image:** The banner should support an optional background image with proper sizing and positioning controls

    * When a background image is provided, it should display properly with the text elements visible and readable
    * When no background image is provided, the background color should be applied
    * It should be possible to set a focus point for the background image to enable optimal display on all end devices
    * There should always be the possibility to upload a desktop and a mobile image
    * It should be possible to optionally switch on a transparent gradient or a transparent color area as an overlay. [In the examples](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4663-127427&t=4XGop48INZdEbUEO-4), you can see that users can select the overlay to match the selected orientation and their design.
    
        * Opacity should be choosable. 
        * Gradient goes from bottom to top: black alpha 12 to black alpha 1, with 40% opacity to the gradient layer
        * Standard full color overlay has black alpha 8 as fill color.
        
    
* **Background Color:** The banner should support a customizable background color when no image is used or as a fallback
* **Responsive Design:** The banner should adapt appropriately to different screen sizes
* **Accessibility:** All elements must be accessible and meet WCAG standards
* **Color Management:** Allow for theme-based or custom color selection

    * Default selection: light background or dark background affect text color and default selected button
    * It should still be possible for the user to change the colors, for example to select a different headline color.
    * To avoid problems with background images and texts in dark mode, users should always have the option:
    
        * select either the font color always-white or always black
        * or select specific font colors for the darkmode
        
    

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-3">:dividers:</custom>  Variants

### CTA Banner **Basic**

The basic banner is the classic CTA banner with a large background image, headline, subline and CTA. It is usually used on landing pages or the home screen to draw customers' attention to collections, a product range or a special occasion.

#### Requirements:

* The user can choose from three banner sizes:

    * S, M, L
    * Standard size M
    * The sizes vary in padding and text size
    
* The banner is responsive by default and adapts in height and width to the content

    * The user has the possibility to change the height of the banner by adding additional height:
    
        * He can then choose between the sizes Small, Default, Medium and Big.
        * If the user has selected a size, this is added to the existing padding (which is depending on screen size and banner size variant)
        
    

| **Small** | **Default** | **Medium** | **Big** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| spacing-ml | spacing-xl | spacing-3xl | spacing-4xl |

* There are the variants "boxed" and "full width"

    * boxed: fits into the page content / a section
    * full width: full screen width
    
* For responsive banner the user can choose between two alignments:

    * center center
    * center left
    
* For mobile devices, screens **smaller than 600px**, the user can also optionally select whether they would like to have a fixed ratio and, of course, upload an extra image for this.

    * Ratios: 1:1 and 4:3 portrait
    * If the user has selected the mobile version with fixed ratio, they can also change the positioning of the content:
    
        * The positioning of the desktop/responsive banner is adopted by default
        * Positioning selection: top center, top left, center center, center left, bottom center, bottom left
        
    
* Can have optional caption flag

#### Design:

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=5491-51300&t=h4wNZc9V9imHBMVW-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=5491-51300&t=h4wNZc9V9imHBMVW-4) 

---

### CTA Banner **Integrated**

The Integrated CTA Banner is a smaller banner than the Basic Banner. Although it is also intended to draw customers' attention, it is mainly used in the content without taking up too much space. It can also often be found on PLPs or wherever you want to give the customer a small hint.

[Design Examples](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6481-79382&t=aejtvcKUluE60mZM-4)

#### Requirements:

* The user can choose from three banner sizes:

    * S, XS
    * Standard size S
    
* The banner is responsive by default and adapts in height and width to the content
* There are the variants "boxed" and "full width"

    * boxed: fits into the page content / a section
    * full width: full screen width
    
* Attention, breakpoint md still uses the desktop background image
* Can have optional caption flag

#### [Design](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6144-110534&t=aejtvcKUluE60mZM-4)

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6144-110534&t=aejtvcKUluE60mZM-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6144-110534&t=aejtvcKUluE60mZM-4) 

---

### CTA Banner **Showcase**

The CTA Banner Showcase is primarily there to promote products. In contrast to the Basic or Integrated banner, it has an additional image in the foreground. It is flexible in terms of content and can be used globally.

[Design Examples](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6689-73076&t=cf0vqhBfKI5kXWI2-4)

**Requirements**:

* The User can upload different aspect ratio images.
* The User can upload desktop and mobile foreground and background image with different ratios.
* The banner is responsive by default and adapts in height and width to the content
* There are the variants "boxed" and "full width"

    * boxed: fits into the page content / a section
    * full width: full screen width
    
* Attention, breakpoint md still uses the desktop foreground and background images
* Can have optional caption flag
* On mobile, the User can choose between left oder center text alignment

**Design**

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6642-71342&t=cf0vqhBfKI5kXWI2-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=6642-71342&t=cf0vqhBfKI5kXWI2-4)
